pages.text: The $(d)More Hearts$() Gene gives entities $(9)10 extra hearts$(). If the Gene is mutated, they instead get $(9)20$().$(br2)This Gene $(9)can be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)1/9 - Enderman$(br)2/19 - Iron Golem$(br)3/17 - Ravager$(br)5/10 - Warden
